source.description: English is a member of the West Germanic group of the Germanic languages. It is an official language of almost 60 sovereign states and is now a global lingua franca.It is the third-most-common native language in the world and it is widely learned as a second language.

L’anglais est une langue appartenant au groupe occidental des langues germaniques. C’est la langue officielle de près de 60 États souverains. De nos jours, l’anglais est une lingua franca mondiale (langue véhiculaire).L’anglais est la troisième langue maternelle la plus parlée dans le monde et la langue la plus étudiée comme deuxième langue.

Adyghe is a Northwest Caucasian language spoken by the western subgroups of Circassians. It is spoken mainly in Russia, as well as in Turkey, Jordan, Syria and Israel, where Circassians settled after the Circassian genocide (c. 1864–1870) by the Russian Empire. It is closely related to the Kabardian (East Circassian) language, and some consider both as dialects of the Circassian language. Adyghe as other Northwest Caucasian languages possesses highly complex sets of consonant distinctions paired with a lack of vowel distinctions.

Afrikaans is a West Germanic language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.

Aimaq or Aimaqi is the dominant eastern Persian ethnolect spoken by the Aimaq people in central northwest Afghanistan (west of the Hazarajat) and eastern Iran. Aimaq is a member of the Western Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family.

Akan is an Atlantic-Congo language that belongs to the Central Tano group of the Volta-Congo languages. It is the principal native language of the Akan people of Ghana, spoken over much of the southern half of Ghana. It is also spoken in parts of Côte d’Ivoire. With the Atlantic slave trade, the language was introduced to the Caribbean and South America, notably in Suriname and in Jamaica. The Akan language and its dialects use the Adinkra Nkyea writing system. It is part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family.

source.description: Arabic is a name for what are traditionally considered the descendants of the Classical Arabic language of the 6th century. This includes both the literary language and varieties of Arabic spoken in a wide arc of territory, stretching across the Middle East, North Africa, the Horn of Africa. Arabic belongs to the Semitic branch of the Afro-Asiatic family. The literary language is called Modern Standard Arabic or Literary Arabic, which is a pluricentric, fusional language. It is currently the only official form of Arabic, used in most written documents as well as in formal spoken occasions, such as lectures and news broadcasts.Arabic is written using the Arabic script.

Parlée d’abord par les Arabes, cette langue sémitique qui se déploie géographiquement sur plusieurs continents s’étend sociologiquement à des peuples non arabes et est aujourd’hui la langue officielle de plusieurs organismes internationaux. L’arabe est aussi une des six langues officielles de l’Organisation des Nations unies.La diglossie est un caractère de la langue arabe, qui permet de distinguer l’arabe vernaculaire de l’arabe littéraire. Le niveau de langue littéraire comprend l’arabe classique (pré-coranique, coranique et post-coranique) et l’arabe standard moderne. Le niveau de langue vernaculaire comprend toutes les variantes des dialectes arabes régionaux.L’arabe utilise l’écriture arabe.

Ayoreo is a Zamucoan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Azerbaijani or Azeri is a member of the Oghuz group of Turkic languages, spoken primarily in the Caucasus region. Azerbaijani and Turkish closely resemble each other.Azeri was written in the Arabic-Persian script, a modified Latin script and with a form of the Cyrillic alphabet. After the collapse of the Soviet Union the Latin writing was introduced.

L’azéri ou azerbaïdjanais est une langue appartenant au groupe oghuz des langues turques, parlée principalement dans la région du Caucase. L’azéri et le turc sont assez similaires.L’azéri a été écrit dans l’alphabet arabo-persan, un alphabet latin modifié et avec une forme de l’alphabet cyrillique. Après la chute de l’Union soviétique, l’écriture latine est introduite.

Bambara, also known as Bamana, is a lingua franca and national language of Mali spoken natively by 4.2 million Bambara people and about 10 million second-language users. Bambara is a variety of a group of closely related languages called Manding, whose native speakers trace their cultural history to the medieval Mali Empire. It has a subject–object–verb clause structure and two lexical tones. Manding languages are a sub-branch of Mande languages that are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

source.description: Belarusian is one of the East Slavic languages and shares many grammatical and lexical features with other members of the branch, Russian and Ukrainian. It is spoken mainly in Belarus.Belorusian is written with the Cyrillic alphabet.

Le biélorusse fait partie de la famille des langues slaves et partage de nombreuses caractéristiques grammaticales et lexicales avec d’autres langues de cette famille, le russe et l’ukrainien. Il est parlé principalement en Biélorussie.Le biélorusse s’écrit avec l’alphabet cyrillique.

Bengali is the language native to the region of Bengal, which comprises present-day Bangladesh and some east-north Indian states. It is written using the Bengali script. Bengali presents a strong case of diglossia, with the literary and standard form differing greatly from the colloquial speech of the regions.On 21 February 1952 several students and political activists were killed during protests. The day was proclaimed the International Mother Language Day by Unesco in 1999 making the Bengali language the only language in the world to be also known for its language movements and people sacrificing their life for their mother language, Bengali.

Le bengali ou bangla est une langue indo-iranienne (sous-branche indo-aryenne) de la famille des langues indo-européennes. Originaire de la région du Bengale à l’est du sous-continent indien, le bengali est la langue nationale du Bangladesh et la langue officielle dans certains États indiens. Le bengali, par sa grande diversité de variantes régionales, forme un continuum linguistique.Le 21 février 1952, plusieurs personnes furent tuées lors de manifestations pour le bengali. Pour cette raison, en 1999, l’Unesco a décidé de commémorer tous les 21 février comme la Journée internationale de la langue maternelle.

source.description: Bislama is an English-based creole language. It is one of the official languages of Vanuatu.

Bajelani is an Indo-Iranian language and considered a dialect of Gorani of the Northwestern Iranian language group with about 59 000 speakers, predominately around Mosul, near Khanaqin and near the Khosar valley.

The Tibetic or Tibetan languages (Bodish) are a cluster of mutually unintelligible Tibeto-Burman languages spoken primarily by Tibetan peoples who live across a wide area of eastern Central Asia bordering the Indian subcontinent, including the Tibetan Plateau and the northern Indian subcontinent in Baltistan, Ladakh, Nepal, Sikkim, and Bhutan. The classical written form is a major regional literary language, particularly for its use in Buddhist literature.Most Tibetic languages are written in an Indic script, with a historically conservative orthography (see below) that helps unify the Tibetan-language area. However, some Ladakhi and Balti speakers write with the Urdu script.

Le tibétain est une langue parlée par plusieurs millions de locuteurs dans l’ancien Tibet, c’est-à-dire la Région autonome du Tibet, les zones à population tibétaine du Qinghai (Amdo), du Gansu, du Sichuan et du Yunnan (Kham) en République populaire de Chine, et dans certaines régions des pays environnants, de l’Himalaya et de l’Asie centrale, comme le Ladakh et le Sikkim en Inde, le Baltistan pakistanais, le Bhoutan et le nord du Népal. Le tibétain est une langue appartenant à la famille des langues tibéto-birmanes. Il se subdivise en un grand nombre de dialectes.L’écriture Phagspa, alphasyllabaire, fut créée comme écriture unifiée pour toutes les langues de l’Empire mongol. Le lama Phagspa la dériva de son écriture natale, l’écriture tibétaine.

Bolon is a Manding language of Burkina Faso. There are two dialects, White/Southern and Black/Northern; White Bolon is partially intelligible with Jula. Manding languages are a sub-branch of Mande languages that are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

Breton is a member of the Brittonic subgroup of the Celtic languages, spoken in Brittany, in western France. It is most closely related to Cornish.Breton is classified as ‘severely endangered’ by the Unesco Atlas of the World’s Languages in Danger.

Le breton est une langue du sous-groupe brittonique des langues celtiques, parlée en Bretagne, dans l’ouest de la France. Il est très proche du cornique.Le breton est reconnu comme langue régionale ou minoritaire de France et comme langue de la région de la Bretagne. Il est classé comme «langue sérieusement en danger» selon l’Unesco.
Baure is an Arawakan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Bulgarian is a member of the Southern subgroup of the Slavic languages, spoken mainly in Bulgaria.Modern Bulgarian has several striking differences from other Slavic languages. e.g. nouns are no longer declined; however, there is a definite article suffixed to the noun.Bulgarian is written with the Cyrillic alphabet.

Le bulgare est une langue du sous-groupe sud des langues slaves. Il est parlé principalement en Bulgarie.Le bulgare a plusieurs caractéristiques qui le distinguent de toutes les autres langues slaves, par exemple l’absence de déclinaison ou l’existence d’un article défini suffixé au nom.Il est écrit avec l’alphabet cyrillique.

Chimane is a Moseten indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Catalan is a member of the Romance family of languages. It is spoken in Catalonia, north-eastern Spain and adjoining parts of France and it is the official language of Andorra. Catalan has a co-official status in the Spanish autonomous communities of Catalonia, the Balearic Islands, and the Valencian Community (where the language is known as Valencian). It is also the language of the city of Alghero on the Italian island Sardinia.

Le catalan est une langue latine. Il est parlé en Catalogne, en Espagne du Nord et dans des parties adjacentes de la France, et est la langue officielle de l’Andorre. Le catalan a un statut coofficiel dans les communautés autonomes espagnoles de Catalogne, les îles Baléares et la Communauté de Valence (où la langue est connue sous le nom de «valencien»). Il est aussi la langue de la ville d’Alghero sur l’île italienne de Sardaigne.

Eastern Min or Min Dong is a branch of the Min group of the Chinese languages of China. The prestige form and most commonly cited representative form is the Fuzhou dialect, the speech of the capital of Fujian.

Czech is a member of the Western subgroup of the Slavic languages, spoken mainly in the Czech Republic.Czech is a fusional language and one of the most highly inflected tongues in the world.
Le tchèque est une langue du sous-groupe occidental des langues slaves, parlée principalement en République tchèque.Le tchèque est une des langues les plus flexionnelles dans le monde.
Chamorro is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands.

Jinyu is a group of Chinese linguistic varieties spoken in northern China, including most of Shanxi province, much of central Inner Mongolia, and adjoining areas in Hebei, Henan, and Shaanxi provinces. The status of Jin is disputed among linguists; some prefer to include it within Mandarin, but others set it apart as a closely related but separate sister group.

Central Kurdish (Sorani) is a Kurdish dialect spoken in Iraq, mainly in Iraqi Kurdistan, as well as the Kurdistan Province of western Iran. The language is written in an adapted form of the Kurdo-Arabic alphabet. The language is part of the Kurdish group within the northwestern branch of the Indo-Iranian languages.

Mandarin is a group of related varieties of Chinese language (a branch of the Sino-Tibetan language family), spoken across most of northern and southwestern China. Since the 14th century, Mandarin has served as a lingua franca for government officials and the courts, which is why it is also known as Guānhuà, meaning officials' speech. All varieties of Mandarin Chinese are tonal and largely analytic. When the Mandarin group is taken as one language, as is often done in academic literature, it has more native speakers (nearly a billion) than any other language.

Le mandarin, est une catégorie des langues chinoises parlée dans le nord et le sud-ouest de la Chine continentale. Envisagée comme une langue, c’est celle qui compte le plus grand nombre de locuteurs dans le monde.

Cornish is a south-western Brittonic Celtic language spoken in Cornwall.Since 2000 the language has undergone a revival. It is a recognised regional language of the United Kingdom, protected under the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages.

Le cornique est une langue celtique insulaire du groupe brittonique, parlée en Cornouailles (au Royaume-Uni).Il est reconnu par le Royaume-Uni comme langue régionale de l’Écosse, selon la charte européenne des langues régionales ou minoritaires.

Corsican is an Italo-Dalmatian Romance language, a member of the South Central group of the dialects of Italy, spoken and written on the islands of Corsica (France) and northern Sardinia (Italy). Unesco classifies Corsican as a definitely endangered language.

Le corse est une langue italo-dalmate romane, membre du groupe centre-sud des dialectes de l’Italie, parlée et écrite sur l’île de Corse (France) et au nord de la Sardaigne (Italie).L’Unesco classe le corse comme une langue définitivement en voie de disparition.

Welsh (Cymraeg) is a member of the Brittonic subgroup of the Celtic languages. It has the status of official language in Wales.Modern standard literary Welsh is a conservative form of the language: this makes it more difficult to learn but those who can read it can also read the early classics.

Le gallois est une langue du sous-groupe brittonique des langues celtiques, parlée principalement au pays de Galles. Il a le statut de langue officielle au pays de Galles.Le gallois littéraire moderne standard est une forme conservatrice de la langue: cela le rend plus difficile à apprendre, mais ceux qui savent le lire peuvent également lire les premiers classiques.

Huizhou Chinese is a group of closely related Sinitic languages spoken over a small area in and around the historical region of Huizhou, plus in southern Anhui and in neighbouring Zhejiang and Jiangxi. Its classification is disputed, with some linguists classifying it as Wu Chinese, others as Gan, and still others setting it apart as a primary branch of Chinese.
Central Min, or Min Zhong is a part of the Min group of varieties of Chinese. It is spoken in the valley of the Sha River in Sanming prefecture in the central mountain areas of Fujian.

Danish is a North Germanic language spoken principally in Denmark and as a second language in the Faroe Islands and Greenland. Danish is largely mutually intelligible with Norwegian and Swedish.Danish has a relatively large vowel inventory and is distinguished by the many pharyngealised sounds.

Le danois est une langue germanique du Nord, parlée principalement au Danemark, et est la deuxième langue dans les Îles Féroé et au Groenland. Le danois est en grande partie mutuellement intelligible avec le norvégien et le suédois.Il possède un inventaire de voyelles relativement vaste et se distingue par ses nombreux sons pharyngalisés.

Dehwari is a southwestern Persian language spoken by 19 000 Dehwar people in Balochistan, Pakistan as of 2018. Dehwari was introduced to the Brahui in the seventeenth century and Brahui has heavily influenced Dehwari. Dehwari is a member of the Western Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family.

German is a West Germanic language, most closely related to Dutch and Yiddish. German is a pluricentric language, with multiple countries having their own standardised variants as well as many dialects. There is also one variant referred to as Standard German.

L’allemand est une langue germanique occidentale, proche du néerlandais et du yiddish. L’allemand est une langue pluricentrique, avec plusieurs pays ayant leurs propres variantes normalisées ainsi que de nombreux dialectes. Il existe aussi une variante dénommée «allemand standard».
Dimli or Southern Zaza is a Northwestern Iranian language spoken primarily in eastern Turkey. The language is a part of the Zaza–Gorani language group of the northwestern group of the Iranian branch.

Dhivehi or Maldivian is an Indo-Aryan language predominantly spoken in the Maldives, where it is the national language. Maldivian is a descendent of Maharashtri Prakrit and is closely related to Marathi, Konkani and Sinhalese languages, but not mutually intelligible with them.Maldivian is written in the Thaana script.
Le divehi ou maldivien est une langue indo-aryenne parlée principalement aux Maldives, où elle est la langue officielle.L’alphabet utilisé est le thâna ou thaana, qui est dérivé de l’arabe.

source.description: Greek is an independent branch of the Indo-European family of languages, native to the southern Balkans, the Aegean Islands, western Asia Minor and Cyprus. It has the longest continuous recorded history of any European language.Its writing system has been the Greek alphabet for the majority of its history.Greek roots are often used to coin new words for other languages; Greek and Latin are the predominant sources of international scientific vocabulary.

Le grec fait partie de la branche indépendante de la famille indo-européenne des langues, principalement parlé dans le sud des Balkans, sur les îles de la mer Égée, en Asie Mineure occidentale et à Chypre. Il a la plus longue histoire enregistrée en continu de toutes les langues européennes.Son système d’écriture a été l’alphabet grec pour la majorité de son histoire.Les racines grecques sont souvent utilisées pour créer de nouveaux mots dans d’autres langues; le grec et le latin sont les principales sources de vocabulaire scientifique international.

Maninka (also known as Malinke), or more precisely Eastern Maninkakan, is the name of several closely related languages and dialects of the southeastern Manding subgroup of the Mande language family. It is the mother tongue of the Malinké people in Guinea, where it is spoken by 3.1 million people and is the main language in the Upper Guinea region, and in Mali, where the closely related Bambara is a national language, as well as in Liberia, Senegal, Sierra Leone and Ivory Coast, where it has no official status. It was the language of court and government during the Mali Empire. Mande languages are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

Esperanto is the most widely spoken constructed international auxiliary language. Its name derives from Doktoro Esperanto (‘Esperanto’ translates as ‘one who hopes’), the pseudonym under which Ludwig Zamenhof published the first book detailing Esperanto, in 1887.This artificial language is Indo-European based, both in its lexicon and in the grammatical categories with which it operates.

L’espéranto est la langue auxiliaire construite internationale la plus parlée. Son nom dérive de «Doktoro Esperanto» («espéranto» se traduit par «celui qui espère»), le pseudonyme sous lequel Ludwig Zamenhof a publié le premier livre détaillant l’espéranto, en 1887.Cette langue artificielle a des bases indo-européennes, à la fois dans son lexique et dans les catégories grammaticales avec lesquels elle opère.

L’estonien appartient, avec le finnois, au sous-groupe balto-finnois des langues finno-ougriennes de la famille ouralienne. Il est la langue officielle de l’Estonie.L’estonien représente une forme de transition d’une langue agglutinante à une langue fusionnelle.

Basque (euskara) is a non Indo-European language of uncertain origin; the only living language of Europe that has no known linguistic relatives. It is spoken by the Basque people, indigenous to and mainly inhabiting the Basque Country, a region spanning an area in north-eastern Spain and south-western France.

Le basque (euskara) est une langue non indo-européenne d’origine incertaine et la seule langue vivante de l’Europe qui n’a pas de parents linguistiques connus. Il s’agit de la langue parlée par le peuple basque, qui est indigène et habite principalement au Pays basque, région couvrant une zone dans le nord-ouest de l’Espagne et le sud-ouest de la France.
Ewe belongs to the Gbe branch of the Niger–Congo language family. It is spoken in southeastern Ghana.
Faroese is a North Germanic language spoken in the Faroe Islands.Faroese grammar is related and very similar to that of modern Icelandic and Old Norse.
Le féroïen ou féringien est une langue germanique du Nord parlée dans les Îles Féroé.La grammaire des Îles Féroé est très proche de celles de l’islandais moderne et du vieux norrois.

Persian is an Iranian language within the Indo-Iranian branch of the Indo-European languages and the only South-Western Iranian language. Apart from being the majority language and the national language in Iran (Persia), a different dialect is spoken in Afghanistan (officially known as Dari since 1958 for political reasons) and in Tajikistan (officially known as Tajiki Persian since the Soviet era for political reasons), and in some other regions. Persian is a pluricentric language and its grammar is similar to that of many contemporary European languages. Modern Iranian Persian and Afghan Persian are written using a modified variant of the Arabic alphabet. Tajik Persian is typically written in a modified version of the Cyrillic alphabet.

Le persan est la langue parlée en Iran (Perse), en Afghanistan et au Tadjikistan en tant que langue officielle, ainsi qu’au Bahreïn (minorité iranophone) et en Ouzbékistan (minorité tadjike). Il appartient au groupe indo-iranien de la famille des langues indo-européennes.De nos jours, les langues persanes s’écrivent surtout au moyen de l’alphabet arabo-persan, variante de l’alphabet arabe. Au Tadjikistan et en Ouzbékistan, la langue tadjike s’écrit en caractères cyrilliques.
Quebec Sign Language is a sign language used in francophone Canada. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Fijian is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Fiji.
Filipino is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of the Philippines.

Finnish belongs (with Estonian) to the Baltic-Finnic subgroup of the Finno-Ugrian languages from the Uralic family. Finnish is one of two official languages of Finland (the other being Swedish).Finnish is typologically between fusional and agglutinative languages.

Le finnois appartient, avec l’estonien, au sous-groupe balto-finnois des langues finno-ougriennes de la famille ouralienne. Le finnois est l’une des deux langues officielles de la Finlande (l’autre étant le suédois).Typologiquement, le finnois se situe entre les langues fusionnelles et agglutinantes.

French is the most northerly of the Romance languages and is an official language in 29 countries. It is an official language of all United Nations agencies and of a large number of international organisations. Outside of France, the highest numbers of French speakers are found in Canada, Belgium, Switzerland and Luxembourg.

Le français est la plus septentrionale des langues romanes et est une langue officielle dans 29 pays. Il est aussi une langue officielle de tous les organismes des Nations unies et d’un grand nombre d’organisations internationales. Hors de France, le plus grand nombre de francophones se trouvent au Canada, en Belgique, en Suisse et au Luxembourg.

Frisian belongs, together with English, to the North Sea subgroup of the West Germanic languages. It is spoken by Frisian ethnic groups, who live mainly in the northern part of the Netherlands.There are three varieties of Frisian: West Frisian, Saterland Frisian, and North Frisian.

Le frison appartient, avec l’anglais, au sous-groupe de la mer du Nord des langues germaniques de l’Ouest. Il est parlé par des groupes ethniques de la Frise, qui vivent principalement dans la partie nord des Pays-Bas.Il est réparti en trois variantes: le frison occidental, le frison oriental et le frison septentrional.

source.description: Fula – also known as Fulah – is a Senegambian language spoken across some 20 countries in West and Central Africa. Along with other related languages such as Serer and Wolof, it belongs to the Senegambian branch within the Niger–Congo family, which does not have tones. It is spoken as a first language by the Fula people. The language mainly uses a version of the Latin alphabet but Arabic script is also used and there was a plan to use a special Adlam script.

Gan is a member of the Sinitic languages of the Sino-Tibetan language family, and Hakka is the closest Chinese variety to Gan in terms of phonetics. It is spoken in the Jiangxi province and the neighbouring provinces.

Scottish Gaelic, sometimes also called Gaelic, is a Celtic language native to Scotland.Gaelic is an official language in Scotland and it is a recognised minority language of the United Kingdom, protected under the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages.

Le gaélique écossais ou écossais est une langue celtique parlée en Écosse.Le gaélique écossais est reconnu par le Royaume-Uni comme langue régionale de l’Écosse, selon la charte européenne des langues régionales ou minoritaires.

Irish, Irish Gaelic, or Gaelic (Gaeilge) belongs to the Gaelic branch of the Celtic family of languages, originating in Ireland and historically spoken by the Irish people.Irish is spoken as a first language by a small minority of Irish people, and as a second language by a rather larger group. Irish enjoys constitutional status as the national and first official language of the Republic of Ireland, and is an officially recognised minority language in Northern Ireland.

L’irlandais, gaélique irlandais ou gaélique (Gaeilge) appartient à la branche gaélique de la famille des langues celtiques, originaires de l’Irlande et historiquement parlées par le peuple irlandais.L’irlandais est utilisé comme première langue par une minorité irlandaise et comme deuxième langue par un groupe beaucoup plus large. L’irlandais bénéficie d’un statut constitutionnel comme langue officielle nationale et première langue de la République d’Irlande, et est une langue minoritaire officiellement reconnue en Irlande du Nord.

Galician (galego) is an Indo-European language of the Western Ibero-Romance branch, closely related to Portuguese. It is spoken mainly in the autonomous region of Galicia, located in north-western Spain.

Le galicien (galego) est une langue indo-européenne de la branche ibéro-romane occidentale, très proche du portugais. Il est principalement parlé dans la région autonome de Galice, située dans le nord-ouest de l’Espagne.
Manx is a Celtic language. It is one of the official languages of the Isle of Man.
Guarani is a Tupian indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia and Paraguay.

Guatemalan Sign Language is a sign language used in Guatemala. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Hanoi Sign Language is a sign language used in Hanoi city in Viet Nam. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Gorani, also known by its main dialect Hawrami is a Northwestern Iranian language spoken by ethnic Kurds in northeastern Iraq and western Iran and which with Zaza constitute the Zaza–Gorani languages. Gorani is considered a Kurdish dialect by many researchers.
Haiphong Sign Language is a sign language used in Haiphong city in Viet Nam. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Hakka is a member of the Sinitic languages of the Sino-Tibetan language family. It is most closely related to Gan and is sometimes classified as a variety of Gan. It is spoken natively by the Hakka people in parts of Southern China, Taiwan, some diaspora areas of Southeast Asia and in overseas Chinese communities around the world.
Haitian is a French-based creole language. It is one of the official languages of Haiti.

Hausa is a Chadic language spoken by the Hausa people, mainly within the northern half of Nigeria and the southern half of Niger, and with significant minorities in Chad, Benin and Cameroon. Hausa is a member of the Afroasiatic language family and is the most widely spoken language within the Chadic branch of that family. Hausa’s modern official orthography is a Latin-based alphabet called boko. Hausa has also been written in Ajami, an Arabic alphabet.

Hazaragi is a member of the Western Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family. It is an eastern variety of Persian and closely related to Dari, one of the two official Languages of Afghanistan. The primary differences between Dari and Hazaragi are the accents and Hazaragi's greater array of many Turkic and Mongolic words and loanwords.

source.description: Serbo-Croatian, also called Serbo-Croat, Serbo-Croat-Bosnian (SCB), or Bosnian-Croatian-Serbian (BCS), is a South Slavic language and the primary language of Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro. It is a pluricentric language with four mutually intelligible standard varieties. The term Serbo-Croatian was widely used in former Yougoslavia.To write Serbo-Croatian, Cyrillic and Latin scripts were equally used and easily interchangeable.

Le serbo-croate, aussi appelé «serbo-croate-bosniaque» (SCB) ou «bosniaque-croate-serbe» (BCS), est une langue slave du Sud et la principale langue de la Serbie, de la Croatie, de la Bosnie-Herzégovine et du Monténégro. C’est une langue pluricentrique avec quatre variantes standards mutuellement intelligibles. Le terme «serbo-croate» a été largement utilisé dans l’ex-Yougoslavie.Pour écrire en serbo-croate, les alphabets latin et cyrillique sont indifféremment utilisés et facilement interchangeables.

Andaman Creole Hindi is a trade language of the Andaman Islands, spoken as a native language especially in Port Blair and villages to the south. It is described as a creolization of Hindustani, Bengali, and Malayalam.

source.description: Hebrew is a North-Western Semitic language of the Afroasiatic language family, employed since biblical times by Jews. It was revived as a spoken and literary language in the 19th century. Modern Hebrew is one of the two official languages of Israel (the other being Arabic), while Classical Hebrew is used for prayer or study in Jewish communities around the world today.Hebrew has always employed a Hebrew script.

L’hébreu est une langue sémitique du Nord-Ouest de la famille des langues afro-asiatiques, utilisée depuis les temps bibliques par les Juifs. Il a été relancé en tant que langue parlée et littéraire au XIXe siècle. L’hébreu moderne est une des deux langues officielles d’Israël (l’autre étant l’arabe), tandis que l’hébreu classique est utilisé pour la prière ou l’étude au sein des communautés juives dans le monde d’aujourd’hui.L’hébreu a toujours utilisé un alphabet hébreu.
Fiji Hindi is an Indo-Aryan language. It is one of the official languages of Fiji. Fiji Hindi is written using both the Latin and Devanagari script.

Hindi, or more precisely Modern Standard Hindi, is a standardised and Sanskritised register of the Hindustani language. Modern Standard Hindi is one of the official languages of India. Hindi is the fourth-most-widely spoken language in the world, but this includes not only Hindu speakers of Hindustani, but also people who identify as native speakers of related languages who consider their speech to be a dialect of Hindi, the Hindi belt.Hindi is written in Devanagari script.

Le hindi est la plus parlée des langues de l’Inde. Utilisée essentiellement dans le nord et le centre de l’Inde, c’est une langue indo-européenne de la branche des langues indo-aryennes, qui en est la plus vaste famille, dérivée du sanskrit et de divers prâkrits, écrite la plupart du temps au moyen de l’alphasyllabaire devanāgarī, qui se lit et s’écrit de gauche à droite. L’ourdou est le nom pakistanais du hindi. Le hindi et l’ourdou sont parfaitement intercompréhensibles et, avant la partition de 1947 entre l’Inde et le Pakistan, constituaient une seule et même langue, appelée «hindoustani».

Tsoa, Tshwa or Tshuwau, also known as Kua and Hiechware, is a language spoken in southwest Africa, belonging to the Khoisan language family. It is considered part of the Khoe-kwadi language group, the northern branch of the Khoisan languages. Tsoa is spoken by about 6 500 people, mainly pastoralists or hunter/gatherers settled in the northeastern part of Botswana and Zimbabwe. One of the dialects is Tjwao (or Tshwao) spoken in Zimbabwe, where it is a language officially recognised in the constitution. Tsoa is a tonal language and is distinguished (like all Khoisan languages) by the presence of numerous click consonants, produced by snapping the tongue against the palate or teeth.

source.description: Croatian is the standardised variety of the Serbo-Croatian language used by Croats, principally in Croatia and in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Standard Croatian is based on the Shtokavian dialect of Serbo-Croatian.Croatian uses exclusively the Latin alphabet.

Le croate est la variante standard de la langue serbo-croate utilisée par les Croates, principalement en Croatie et en Bosnie-Herzégovine. Sa norme est basée sur le dialecte chtokavien du serbo-croate.Le croate utilise exclusivement l’alphabet latin.
Upper Sorbian is a minority language spoken by Sorbs in Germany in the historical province of Upper Lusatia, which is today part of Saxony. It is grouped in the West Slavic language branch.
Le haut-sorabe est une langue parlée en Allemagne, dans la province historique de Lusace, aujourd’hui en Saxe. Il appartient à la famille occidentale des langues slaves.
Hungarian Sign Language is a sign language used in Hungary. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Hausa Sign Language is a sign language used in Kano city in Nigeria. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Xiang or Hsiang also known as Hunanese, is a group of linguistically similar and historically related Sinitic languages, spoken mainly in Hunan province but also in northern Guangxi and parts of neighboring Guizhou, Guangdong, Sichuan, Jiangxi and Hubei provinces.

Hungarian (Magyar), like Finnish and Estonian, belongs to the Finno-Ugric branch of the Uralic language family. It is the official language of Hungary and is also spoken by communities of Hungarian people in neighbouring countries.In Hungarian, surnames precede Christian names.

Le hongrois (magyar), comme l’estonien et le finnois, appartient à la branche finno-ougrienne de la famille des langues ouraliennes. Il est la langue officielle de la Hongrie et est également parlé par les communautés hongroises dans les pays voisins.En hongrois, les noms de famille précèdent les prénoms.

The Armenian language (hayeren) forms an independent branch of the Indo-European family. It is spoken in the Republic of Armenia (where it is the official language), in Nagorno-Karabakh, in north-western Iran and in the Armenian diaspora.Armenian has its own unique script, the Armenian alphabet, invented by Mesrop Mashtots in the 5th century AD.

L’arménien (hayeren) constitue une branche indépendante de la famille indo-européenne. Il est parlé dans la République d’Arménie (où il est la langue officielle), dans le Haut-Karabakh, dans le nord-ouest de l’Iran et dans la diaspora arménienne.L’arménien a son propre système d’écriture unique, l’alphabet arménien, inventé par Mesrop Maštoc’ au Ve siècle.
Igbo belongs to the Igboid branch of the Niger–Congo language family. It is the principal native language of the Igbo people, an ethnic group of southeastern Nigeria.
Icelandic Sign Language is a sign language used in Iceland. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Ignaciano is an Arawakan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Interlingua is an international auxiliary language (IAL), a modern version of Latin, developed between 1937 and 1951 by the International Auxiliary Language Association. It ranks among the top three most widely used IALs (after Esperanto and perhaps Ido), and is the most widely used naturalistic IAL: in other words, its vocabulary, grammar and other characteristics are derived from natural languages. Interlingua was developed to combine a simple, mostly regular grammar with a vocabulary common to the widest possible range of languages, making it unusually easy to learn. Conversely, it is used as a rapid introduction to many natural languages. Interlingua literature maintains that (written) Interlingua is comprehensible to the hundreds of millions of people who speak a Romance language.

L’interlingua désigne aujourd’hui la langue construite élaborée par l’International Auxiliary Language Association (IALA). La construction de l’interlingua par l’IALA fut achevée en 1951. Le vocabulaire de l’interlingua est emprunté essentiellement aux langues romanes ainsi qu’à l’anglais du fait qu’une grande partie de son vocabulaire est d’origine romane. La grammaire est également inspirée de ces langues, mais avec des simplifications. Il existe aujourd’hui une Union mondiale pour l’interlingua (Union Mundial pro Interlingua), qui compte des adhérents dans le monde entier. On trouve aussi une abondante littérature en interlingua, ainsi que des sites internet et des revues.

Indonesian is the official language of Indonesia. It is a standardised register of Malay, an Austronesian language which has been used as a lingua franca in the Indonesian archipelago for centuries. Most Indonesians also speak one of more than 700 indigenous languages. Most formal education, and nearly all national media and other forms of communication, are conducted in Indonesian. The Indonesian name for the language is Bahasa Indonesia (literally ‘the language of Indonesia’).

L’indonésien (bahasa Indonesia, littéralement «langue de l’Indonésie») est la langue officielle de la République d’Indonésie. C’est aussi l’une des langues d’usage dans la République démocratique du Timor-Oriental. L’indonésien est l’une des formes du malais (bahasa Melayu). Pour une majorité d’Indonésiens, ce n’est pas leur langue maternelle. Ils ne l’apprennent à l’école que vers l’âge de 5 ans.
Indonesian Sign Language is a sign language used in Indonesia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Indian Sign Language is a sign language used in India. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Italian Sign Language is a sign language used in Italia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Irish Sign Language is a sign language used in Ireland and in Northern Ireland. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Icelandic is an Indo-European language belonging to the North Germanic or Nordic branch of the Germanic languages. The vast majority of Icelandic speakers live in Iceland. Most Icelanders do not have surnames but patronymics. Forenames are followed by the genitive form of the father’s (or the mother’s) Christian name completed by son (son of …) or dóttir (daughter of …), e.g. Jónsson, Jónsdóttir if the name of the father is Jón.

L’islandais est une langue indo-européenne appartenant à la branche nord germanique des langues germaniques. La grande majorité des locuteurs islandais vivent en Islande. La plupart des Islandais n’ont pas de noms de famille mais des patronymes. Les prénoms sont suivis par la forme au génitif du prénom du père (ou de la mère), complétée par «son» (fils de …) ou «dóttir» (fille de …), par exemple les enfants de Jón s’appellent ainsi Jónsson et Jónsdóttir.
Israeli Sign Language is a sign language used in Israel. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Italian is a member of the Romance language group, spoken mainly in south Europe. Among the Romance languages, Italian is the closest to Latin in terms of vocabulary. The Italian language adopted by the state after the unification of Italy is based on Tuscan.Many Italian speakers are native bilinguals of both standardised Italian and other regional variants.

L’italien est une langue appartenant au groupe des langues romanes, parlée principalement en Europe du Sud. Parmi les langues romanes, l’italien est très proche du latin en termes de vocabulaire. La langue italienne adoptée par l’État après l’unification de l’Italie est fondée sur le dialecte de la Toscane.De nombreux locuteurs italiens sont bilingues et parlent aussi bien l’italien standard que les autres variantes régionales.
Itene is a Chapacuran indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.
Itonama is an indigenous language isolate. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Jahanka is a Manding language of Guinea-Bissau and Guinea. It is partially intelligible with Mandinka. Manding languages are a sub-branch of Mande languages that are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

source.description: Judeo-Tat or Juhuri is a Judeo-Persian dialect and the traditional language spoken by the Mountain Jews in the eastern Caucasus Mountains, especially Azerbaijan, parts of Russia and today in Israel. It belongs to the southwestern group of the Iranian division of the Indo-European languages, albeit with heavy influence from Hebrew.
Jhankot Sign Language is a sign language used in Jhankot village in Nepal. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Jordanian Sign Language is a sign language used in Jordania. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Japanese is an East Asian language spoken primarily in Japan. It is a member of the Japonic (or Japanese-Ryukyuan) language family, whose relation to other language groups is debated. Japanese has no genetic relationship with Chinese, but it makes extensive use of Chinese characters, or kanji, in its writing system, and a large portion of its vocabulary is borrowed from Chinese. Along with kanji, the Japanese writing system primarily uses two syllabic (or moraic) scripts, hiragana and katakana. Latin script is used in a limited way, such as for imported acronyms, and the numeral system uses mostly Arabic numerals, alongside traditional Chinese numerals.

Le japonais est la langue du Japon, parlée par le peuple japonais. Le japonais appartient à la famille isolée des langues japoniques. La langue japonaise utilise conjointement deux ensembles de caractères distincts: les kanjis, écriture logographique d’origine chinoise, et les kanas, système moraïque dérivé des kanjis. Les kanas se divisent eux-mêmes en deux groupes, les hiraganas et les katakanas. Les katakanas sont employés pour l’écriture de mots d’origine étrangère au Japon, et les hiraganas, pour noter la plupart des mots et affixes grammaticaux.

Judeo-Persian refers to both a group of Jewish dialects spoken by the Jews living in Iran and Judeo-Persian texts (written in Hebrew alphabet). As a collective term, Judeo-Persian refers to a number of Judeo-Iranian languages spoken by Jewish communities throughout the formerly extensive Persian Empire. The language is part of the Persian group of the southwestern family of the Indo-Iranian languages.
Japanese Sign Language is a sign language used in Japan. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Jumla Sign Language is a sign language used in Jumla village in Nepal. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Greenlandic (Kalaallisut) is an Eskimo-Aleut language spoken by a small group of usually Danish-Greenlandic bilingual Inuit people in Greenland. It is closely related to the Inuit languages in Canada.Greenlandic is a polysynthetic language that allows the creation of long words by stringing together roots and suffixes. Both nouns and verbs have complex derivational morphology.

Le groenlandais (kalaallisut) est une langue eskimo-aléoute parlée par un petit groupe de personnes inuites, en général bilingues danois-groenlandais, au Groenland. Il est très proche des langues inuites au Canada.Le groenlandais est une langue polysynthétique qui permet la création de longs mots en enchaînant les racines et les suffixes. Les noms et les verbes ont également une morphologie dérivationnelle complexe.

The Kassonke (Khassonké) language, Xaasongaxango (Xasonga) is a Manding language spoken by the Khassonké and Malinke of western Mali. Kassonke is an official language in Mali. Western and Eastern Maninka are 90% mutually intelligible, though distinct from the Mandinka (Malinke) of southern Senegal, which is a national language there. Manding languages are a sub-branch of Mande languages that are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

Georgian (Kartuli) is the most widely spoken of the Caucasian languages. It is the official language of Georgia.Georgian is written in its own unique writing system, the Georgian script.Georgian is the literary language for all regional subgroups of Georgians, including those who speak other Kartvelian languages.

Le géorgien (kartuli) est la plus parlée des langues caucasiennes. C’est la langue officielle de la Géorgie.Le géorgien a son propre système d’écriture unique, l’alphabet géorgien.Le géorgien est la langue littéraire pour tous les sous-groupes régionaux de Géorgiens, y compris ceux qui parlent d’autres langues kartvéliennes.

Kazakh is a Turkic language belonging to the Kipchak (or North-Western Turkic) branch. Kazakh is primarily a Central Asian language and is spoken in Europe in the region between the lower Volga and the frontier of Kazakhstan.Today, Kazakh is written in Cyrillic in Kazakhstan and Mongolia, while the Kazakh-speakers in China use an Arabic-derived alphabet similar to that used to write Uyghur.

Le kazakh est une langue appartenant à la famille des langues turques. Il est parlé en Asie centrale, principalement au Kazakhstan, où il est la langue nationale, et au Xinjiang.Le kazakh est écrit de différentes manières: en utilisant une variante de l’alphabet latin proche de celle utilisée en turc, l’alphabet arabe modifié (en Chine, en Iran, dans une petite partie de la Mongolie, en Afghanistan) et le cyrillique agrémenté de 9 lettres supplémentaires, qui est l’écriture officielle au Kazakhstan.Le kazakh est particulièrement proche du kirghiz.

Kalanga is a Bantu language spoken by the Kalanga people in Botswana and Zimbabwe with an extensive phoneme inventory. Kalanga is recognised as an official language by the Zimbabwean Constitution of 2013 and is taught in schools in areas where its speakers predominate. The Kalanga language is closely related to the Nambya, TshiVenda and KheLobedu languages of Zimbabwe and South Africa.
Selangor Sign Language is a sign language used in Malaysia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Khmer, or Cambodian, is the second most widely spoken Austroasiatic language (after Vietnamese). It is the language of the Khmer people and the official language of Cambodia.Khmer is primarily an analytic, isolating language which is not tonal.The Khmer language is written with an abugida ‘Khmer script’.

Le khmer est une langue appartenant au groupe des langues môn-khmères de la famille des langues austro-asiatiques. Langue des populations khmères, il est principalement parlé au Cambodge et dans les régions limitrophes de Thaïlande par les Khmers Surin (du Nord) et au Viêt Nam par les Khmers Krom, ce qui s’explique par l’histoire de ces pays.C’est une langue non tonale, contrairement au vietnamien, l’autre grande langue môn-khmère.Le système d’écriture du khmer est alphasyllabique.
Kinyarwanda is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of Rwanda.

Kyrgyz is a Turkic language spoken in Kyrgyzstan as well as China, Afghanistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkey, Uzbekistan, Pakistan and Russia. Kyrgyz is a member of the Kyrgyz–Kipchak subgroup of the Kypchak languages, and modern-day language convergence has resulted in a mutual intelligibility between Kyrgyz and Kazakh.In 1940 a Cyrillic alphabet eventually became common and has remained so to this day, though some Kyrgyz still use the Arabic alphabet. There was a popular idea among some Kyrgyz people to make a transition to the Latin alphabet, but the plan has not been implemented yet.

Le kirghiz ou kirghize est une langue appartenant au groupe des langues turques de la famille des langues altaïques. Il est parlé en Asie centrale, principalement au Kirghizstan (où il est la langue nationale), au Tadjikistan, au Xinjiang et en Afghanistan.On l’écrit au moyen de l’alphabet cyrillique, auquel trois lettres sont ajoutées, mais le kirghiz est parfois écrit en utilisant l’alphabet arabe, lui aussi complété. Le kirghiz est très proche du kazakh. Il est habituellement classé avec celui-ci ainsi que le tatar et le karakalpak au sein du groupe des langues kiptchak (ou branche turque occidentale).

Kirmanjki (Kirmanckî) or Northern Zaza is an Indo-Iranian language spoken primarily in eastern Turkey. The language is a part of the Zaza–Gorani language group of the northwestern group of the Iranian branch.

Northern Kurdish (Kurmanji) is a group of Kurdish dialects predominantly spoken in southeast Turkey, northwest Iran, northern Iraq and northern Syria. Northern Kurdish uses the Latin script. It is part of the Kurdish group within the northwestern branch of the Indo-Iranian languages.
Kikongo is a Bantu language.

Korean is the official language of South Korea and North Korea. For over a millennium, Korean was written with adapted Chinese characters called hanja, complemented by phonetic systems like hyangchal, gugyeol, and idu. In the 15th century, a national writing system called hangul was commissioned by Sejong the Great, but it only came into widespread use in the 20th century.Most historical linguists classify Korean as a isolate language with no known relationship to any other languages.

Le coréen est une langue utilisée en Corée du Nord et en Corée du Sud. La classification du coréen est encore controversée. La plupart des linguistes le considèrent comme un isolat, tandis que d’autres le regroupent dans une hypothétique famille altaïque.L’alphabet qui sert à écrire le coréen est le hangeul; les hanja (sinogrammes employés dans cette langue) sont également utilisés, une assez grande partie du lexique étant d’origine chinoise.

Kurdish is a member of the Iranian subgroup of the Indo-European languages, spoken by the Kurdish people in Iran, Iraq, Turkey and Syria. The term ‘Kurdish languages’ is also used instead of ‘Kurdish language’ because the dialects are not mutually intelligible without acquired bilingualism and the languages spoken by Kurds do not form a linguistic group. The principal Northern dialect, Kurmanji is written in the Latin alphabet while others use the Arabic script.

Le kurde est une langue appartenant au sous-groupe iranien des langues indo-européennes, parlée par le peuple kurde en Iran, en Iraq, en Turquie et en Syrie. Le terme «langues kurdes» est également utilisé à la place de «langue kurde», parce que les dialectes ne sont pas mutuellement intelligibles sans bilinguisme acquis et les langues parlées par les Kurdes ne forment pas un groupe linguistique.Le principal dialecte du Nord, Kurmanjo, est écrit avec l’alphabet latin, tandis que d’autres utilisent l’alphabet arabe.
Korean Sign Language is a sign language used in South Korea. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Brunei Malay is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is the national language of Brunei and a lingua franca in parts of East Malaysia.

Lao or Laotian is a tonal language of the Tai–Kadai language family. It is the official language of Laos, and also spoken in the north-east of Thailand.Lao, like many languages in Laos, is written in the Lao script, which is an abugida script.Although there is no official standard, the Vientiane dialect has become the de facto standard.

Le lao ou laotien est une langue du groupe taï de la branche dite «kam-taï» de la famille des langues taï-kadaï. C’est la langue officielle du Laos. La langue lao peut être divisée en cinq dialectes différents selon la région. Le lao de Vientiane est en général bien compris dans tout le pays.L’alphabet laotien est basé sur l’alphabet siamois ancien, comme pour l’alphabet thaï.

Latin is an extinct Indo-European language which was spoken in the ancient city of Rome and its empire. Modern Romance languages are continuations of dialectal forms (vulgar Latin) of the language.Additionally many students, scholars, and some members of the Christian clergy speak it fluently, and it is still taught in some educational institutions around the world. Latin is still used in the creation of new words in modern languages of many different families, and largely in biological taxonomy.

Le latin est une langue indo-européenne, souvent considérée comme une langue morte, qui a été parlée dans la Rome antique et son empire. Les langues romanes modernes sont des continuations des formes dialectales (latin vulgaire) de la langue.De nombreux étudiants, des chercheurs et des membres du clergé chrétien parlent encore couramment le latin, et il est toujours enseigné dans certains établissements d’enseignement à travers le monde. Le latin est encore utilisé dans la création de nouveaux mots dans les langues modernes de nombreuses familles, en particulier dans la taxonomie biologique.

Latvian is one of the two living members of the Baltic languages, the other being Lithuanian. It is the official language of Latvia.Latvian is more innovative, especially in morphology than Lithuanian.

Le letton ou lette est l’un des deux membres vivants des langues baltes, l’autre étant le lituanien. C’est la langue officielle de la Lettonie.Le letton est plus novateur, en particulier dans la morphologie, que le lituanien.
Libyan Sign Language is a sign language used in Libya. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Leco is an indigenous language isolate. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.
Lingala is a Bantu language.

Lithuanian is one of the two living members of the Baltic languages, the other being Latvian. It is the official language of Lithuania.The Lithuanian language is often said to be the most conservative living Indo-European language, retaining many features of Proto-Indo-European now lost in other Indo-European languages.

Le lituanien est l’un des deux membres vivants des langues baltes, l’autre étant le letton. C’est la langue officielle de la Lituanie.Le lituanien est souvent dit la langue indo-européenne vivante la plus conservatrice, gardant de nombreuses caractéristiques de l’indo-européen aujourd’hui perdues dans d’autres langues indo-européennes.

Laki is a vernacular that consists of two dialects; Pish-e Kuh Laki and Posht-e Kuh Laki. Laki has a disputed identity and is considered to be a dialect of Kurdish or of Luri, or a transitional dialect between them. It is considered a Kurdish dialect by most linguists and is spoken chiefly in the area between Khorramabad and Kermanshah in Iran by about 680 000 native speakers. Laki is part of the Kurdish group within the northwestern branch of the Indo-Iranian languages.

source.description: Middle Chinese (formerly known as Ancient Chinese) or the Qieyun system (QYS) is the historical variety of Chinese recorded in the Qieyun, a rime dictionary first published in 601 and followed by several revised and expanded editions. Most scholars now believe that it records a compromise between northern and southern reading and poetic traditions from the late Northern and Southern dynasties period. This composite system contains important information for the reconstruction of the preceding system of Old Chinese phonology. Linguists sometimes refer to the system of the Qieyun as Early Middle Chinese and the variant revealed by the rime tables as Late Middle Chinese.

source.description: Luxembourgish is a Germanic language which belongs to the West Moselle Franconian subgroup of German dialects. Luxembourgish is spoken mainly in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.
Le luxembourgeois est une langue germanique qui appartient au sous-groupe du moyen francique de dialectes allemands. Le luxembourgeois est parlé principalement dans le Grand-Duché de Luxembourg.
Luba-Lulua is a Bantu language.

Classical Chinese or Literary Chinese is the language in which the classics of Chinese literature were written, from c. the 5th century BC. For millennia thereafter, the written Chinese used in these works was imitated and iterated upon by scholars in a form now called Literary Chinese, which was used for almost all formal writing in China until the early 20th century. Each written character corresponds to a single spoken syllable, and almost always to a single independent word. As a result, the characteristic style of the language is comparatively terse.
Marshallese is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of the Marshall Islands.

The Manding languages are mutually intelligible dialects or languages in West Africa of the Mande family. Their best-known members are Bambara (bam), the most widely spoken language in Mali; Mandinka (mnk), the main language of Gambia; Maninka or Malinké, a major language of Guinea; and Dyula (dyu), a trade language of the northern Ivory Coast and western Burkina Faso. There is debate over whether Mande languages are part of the larger Niger-Kongo language family.
Maltese Sign Language is a sign language used in Malta. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Mexican Sign Language is a sign language used in Mexico. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Minangkabau is an Austronesian language spoken by the Minangkabau of West Sumatra. The language is also a lingua franca along the western coastal region of the province of North Sumatra, and is even used in parts of Aceh, where the language is called Aneuk Jamee. It is also spoken in some parts of Malaysia.There are great grammatical similarities between the Minangkabau language and Malay.

Le minangkabau est une langue austronésienne parlée en Indonésie, dans le nord de l’île de Sumatra.Il fait partie des langues malaïques qui représentent un des sous-groupes du malayo-polynésien occidental.

Le macédonien est une langue appartenant au sous-groupe méridional des langues slaves, parlée principalement en Macédoine du Nord.

Malagasy is an Austronesian language and the national language of Madagascar. Most people in Madagascar speak it as a first language as do some people of Malagasy descent elsewhere. The Malagasy language is the westernmost member of the Malayo-Polynesian branch of the Austronesian language family. It is related to the Malayo-Polynesian languages of Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines, and more closely to the East Barito languages spoken in Borneo.

Le malgache ou malagasy est la langue nationale de Madagascar. C’est depuis toujours une langue normalisée, principalement dérivée du dialecte parlé sur les hauts plateaux centraux. Elle est la plus occidentale des langues malayo-polynésiennes et donc des langues austronésiennes. Plus précisément, elle appartient au rameau dit «Grand Barito». Dans cette région, la langue dominante est aujourd’hui le malais, qui appartient à un autre rameau malayo-polynésien. Le malgache est également utilisé à Mayotte sous le nom de «kibushi» ou «bushi».

Western Maninkakan (Maninka, Malinke) is a Manding language spoken by the Malinke of eastern Senegal. Western and Eastern Maninka are 90% mutually intelligible, though distinct from the Mandinka of southern Senegal, which is a national language there. Manding languages are a sub-branch of Mande languages that are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

Maltese is a Semitic language, historically a dialect of Arabic, spoken in Malta. About half of the vocabulary is derived from standard Italian and Sicilian; English words also make up an important part of the Maltese vocabulary.It is the only Semitic language written in the Latin script in its standard form.

Le maltais est une langue sémitique, historiquement un dialecte de l’arabe, parlé à Malte. Environ la moitié du vocabulaire est dérivé de l’italien standard et de Sicile; les mots anglais constituent également une partie importante du vocabulaire maltais.Il est la seule langue sémitique écrite en alphabet latin dans sa forme standard.

Mandinka (Mandingo) is a Mande language spoken by the Mandinka people in Senegal, the Gambia and Guinea-Bissau. Mandinka is written by Latin or Arabic scripts. Mande languages are part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family. However, as the Mande languages lack the noun-class morphology, linguists increasingly treat Mande and Atlantic–Congo as independent language families and reject the Niger-Congo hypothesis.

Min Bei Chinese or Northern Min is a group of Min varieties spoken in Nanping prefecture of northwestern Fujian. Early classifications of varieties of Chinese, divided Min into Northern and Southern subgroups. Later on, it was argued that the primary split was between inland and coastal groups. In a reclassification that has been followed by most dialectologists since, Northern Min was restricted to inland dialects of Nanping prefecture, and the coastal dialects were classified as Eastern Min.

The Mongolian language is the best-known member of the Mongolic language family.In Mongolia, the Khalkha dialect, written in Cyrillic, is predominant, while in Inner Mongolia, the language is dialectally more diverse and is written in the traditional Mongolian script.

Le mongol est une langue appartenant au groupe des langues mongoles. Il est parlé en Mongolie et en Chine (notamment en Mongolie-Intérieure), ainsi qu’en Russie (notamment en Bouriatie et en Kalmoukie).Le mongol est un ensemble de langues et de dialectes qui utilisent de nombreuses formes d’écritures. Différentes écritures ont été créées spécifiquement pour cette langue, mais d’autres ont également été utilisées pour retranscrire les langues mongoles, telles que les caractères chinois han, l’alphabet latin et l’alphabet cyrillique légèrement modifié.
Machinere is an Arawakan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Burmese is a Sino-Tibetan language. It is the official language of Myanmar. The Burmese alphabet is a Brahmic script, an abugida writing system.

Minnan or Southern Min is a group of linguistically similar and historically related Chinese languages that form a branch of Min Chinese spoken in Fujian, most of Taiwan, Eastern Guangdong, Hainan and Southern Zhejiang.
Nauruan is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Nauru.
Southern Ndebele is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.
Namibian Sign Language is a sign language used in Namibia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Nicaraguan Sign Language is a sign language used in Nicaragua. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Ndau is a Bantu language spoken by 1 400 000 people in central Mozambique and southeastern Zimbabwe. Ndau is part of a continuum with other neighboring varieties of the Shona group and has often been included as a Shona dialect. The 2013 Constitution of Zimbabwe accorded Ndau status as an official language.

North Ndebele is the language spoken by the Zimbabwe Ndebele, also known as Matabele, in the Matabeleland region around the city of Bulawayo. It's a Bantu language of the Nguni group, closely related to Zulu. The Ndebele people of Zimbabwe are descendants of the followers of the Zulu military leader Mzilikazi, who left his home region in the early 19th century. North Ndebele is one of Zimbabwe‘s 16 official languages.

Nepali or Nepalese is an Indo-Aryan language. It is the official language and de facto lingua franca of Nepal and is also spoken in India, Bhutan, Myanmar, Hong Kong and United Kingdom. Nepali developed in proximity to a number of Indo-Aryan languages, most notably Pahari and Magahi, and shows Sanskrit influences. Nepali language shares important lexical similarity with the Bengali language.The language is written by devanagari.

Le népalais est une langue de la famille indo-iranienne, parlée au Népal, en Inde et au Bhoutan. C’est la plus orientale des langues pahari, un groupe de langues et de dialectes parlés au pied de l’Himalaya depuis l’est du Népal jusqu’aux États indiens de l’Uttaranchal et de l’Himachal Pradesh.Le népalais s’écrit en devanagari.
Niuean is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Niue.

Dutch is a West Germanic language whose closest relative is German. It is spoken in the Netherlands, by about 60% of the population of Belgium, in Suriname and in the Caribbean island nations of Aruba, Curaçao, and Sint Maarten. The version of Dutch spoken in Southern Africa has been standardised into Afrikaans.

Le néerlandais est une langue germanique occidentale, dont le plus proche parent est l’allemand. Elle est parlée aux Pays-Bas, en Belgique (par environ 60 % de la population), au Suriname et dans les pays insulaires des Caraïbes (Aruba, Curaçao et Sint-Maarten). La version du néerlandais parlé en Afrique du Sud a été normalisée comme l’afrikaans.

Nambya is a Bantu language spoken by the Nambya people. It is spoken in northwestern Zimbabwe, particularly in the town of Hwange with a few speakers in northeastern Botswana. It is either classified as a dialect of Kalanga or as a closely related language. The Zimbabwean constitution recognises Nambya and Kalanga as separate indigenous languages. Nambya is one of Zimbabwe‘s 16 official languages.

source.description: Old Chinese, also called Archaic Chinese in older works, is the oldest attested stage of Chinese, and the ancestor of all modern varieties of Chinese. The earliest examples of Chinese are divinatory inscriptions on oracle bones from around 1250 BC, in the Late Shang period. Bronze inscriptions became plentiful during the following Zhou dynasty. The latter part of the Zhou period saw a flowering of literature, including classical works such as the Analects, the Mencius, and the Zuo Zhuan.

Occitan is the generic name for Romance idioms which are native mainly to southern France. There are polemics about the unity of the language, as some think that Occitan is a macrolanguage. There is no single written standard language called ‘Occitan’, and Occitan has no official status in France, home to most of Occitania.

L’occitan est le nom générique pour les idiomes romans originaires principalement du sud de la France. Il y a polémique sur l’unité de la langue, certains pensant que l’occitan est une macrolangue. Il n’y a pas de langue écrite standard intitulée «occitan», et l’occitan n’a pas de statut officiel en France, qui abrite la majeure partie de l’Occitanie.

source.description: Ossetic or Ossetian is a member of the Iranian subgroup of the Indo-European languages. It is spoken in Ossetia, a region on the northern Caucasus.Written Ossetian may be immediately recognised by its use of the Cyrillic letter Ae (Ӕ ӕ), a letter to be found in no other language using Cyrillic script.

L’ossète est une langue appartenant au sous-groupe iranien de la famille des langues indo-européennes. Il est parlé en Ossétie, région située dans le Caucase septentrional.L’ossète écrit peut être immédiatement reconnu grâce à son utilisation de la lettre cyrillique Ae (Ӕ ӕ), lettre que l’on ne trouve dans aucune autre langue utilisant l’alphabet cyrillique.

Punjabi is an Indo-Aryan language spoken by over 100 million native speakers worldwide. It is the native language of the Punjabi people in India and Pakistan. Punjabi is written in both the Shahmukhi and the Gurmukhi scripts.
Papiamento is a Portugal-based creol language. It is one of the official languages of Aruba and Curaçao.
Palauan is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Palau.
Pacahuara is a Panoan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Old Persian, the language of the Achaemenid Empire, is one of two directly attested Old Iranian languages (the other being Avestan) and is the ancestor of Middle Persian (the language of the Sasanian Empire).

Iranian Persian or Western Farsi is an Indo-European language, more specifically an Indo-Iranian language and the variety of the Persian language spoken in Iran. It is written using a modified variant of the Arabic alphabet.
Pahlavani is an extinct variety of Persian that was spoken in Afghanistan. Pahlavani is a member of the Western Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family.
Pitcairn-Norfolk is an English-based creole language. It is one of the official languages of Pitcairn Island and Norfolk Island.
Pakistan Sign Language is a sign language used in Pakistan. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Polish is the eastern member of the Lechitic branch of the West Slavic languages. It is spoken primarily in Poland.Polish is the second most widely spoken Slavic language, after Russian.
Le polonais fait partie de la branche léchitique des langues slaves de l’Ouest. Il est parlé principalement en Pologne. Le polonais est la deuxième langue slave la plus utilisée après le russe.

Portuguese is a member of the Ibero-Romance subgroup of the Romance languages. It is spoken in Portugal, Brazil, Mozambique, Angola, Cape Verde, Guinea-Bissau, São Tomé and Príncipe, Macau (China), Equatorial Guinea and East Timor.Portuguese is the major language of the southern hemisphere.

Le portugais est une langue appartenant au sous-groupe ibéro-roman des langues romanes. Il est parlé au Portugal, au Brésil, au Mozambique, en Angola, au Cap-Vert, en Guinée-Bissau, à Sao Tomé-et-Principe, à Macao (Chine), en Guinée équatoriale et au Timor-Oriental.Le portugais est la langue la plus parlée de l’hémisphère Sud.
Peruvian Sign Language is a sign language used in Peru. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Dari is an Indo-European language, more specifically an Indo-Iranian language and an eastern variety of the Persian language spoken in Afghanistan. It is written using a modified variant of the Arabic alphabet.

Providencia Sign Language is a village sign language of Providence Island in the Western Caribbean. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Persian Sign Language is a sign language used in Iran. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

It has extra letters for Pashto-specific sounds.

Les locuteurs du pachto sont les Pachtounes.Cette langue s’écrit au moyen d’un alphabet arabe modifié.Le pachto est composé de deux dialectes principaux, celui de Kandahar et celui de Paktiyâ (ou de Peshawar).
Quechua or Southern Quechua is a Quachuan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia and Peru.

source.description: Romani (also Romany or Gypsy) is a Balkanised neo-Indo-European language belonging to the Indo-Aryan branch. It is spoken principally in Europe by Romani people.The alphabets used in the different varieties of the Romany generally correspond to those countries where the corresponding Roma communities live. The alphabets of use are the Latin, the Cyrillic, the Arabic and the Greek alphabets.

Le romani est une langue néo-indo-européenne balkanisée appartenant à la branche indo-aryenne. Il est parlé principalement en Europe par les Roms.Les alphabets utilisés dans les différentes variantes du romani correspondent généralement à ceux des pays où vivent les communautés roms concernées. Les alphabets utilisés sont le latin, le cyrillique, l’arabe et le grec.

Romanian is a Romance language spoken principally in Romania and Moldova. Much of the total Romanian vocabulary is derived from Latin.Romanian has four varieties: Daco-Romanian, Istro-Romanian, Aromanian and Megleno-Romanian.

Le roumain est une langue romane parlée principalement en Roumanie et en Moldavie. Une grande partie du vocabulaire roumain total est dérivée du latin.Le roumain possède quatre dialectes: le daco-roumain, l’istro-roumain, l’aroumain et le mégléno-roumain.

Kirundi is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of Burundi.

Russian is an East Slavic language with a close relation to Ukrainian and Belarusian. It is an official or unofficial but widely spoken language in some countries that were once constituent republics of the Soviet Union.Russian is the most geographically widespread language of Eurasia and the most widely spoken of the Slavic languages.Russian is written by Cyrillic alphabet.

Le russe est une langue slave orientale et est proche de l’ukrainien et du biélorusse. Le russe est une langue officielle ou non mais parlée dans certains pays qui étaient auparavant des républiques de l’Union soviétique.C’est la langue de l’Eurasie la plus étendue géographiquement et la langue slave la plus parlée.Le russe est écrit avec l’alphabet cyrillique.
Sango is a Ngbandi-based creole language. It is one of the official languages of the Central African Republic.

Scots is the Germanic language variety spoken in Lowland Scotland and parts of Ulster.It is a recognised regional language of the United Kingdom, protected under the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages.

Le scots est une langue germanique parlée en Écosse et dans le nord de l’Irlande.Il est reconnu par le Royaume-Uni comme langue régionale de l’Écosse, selon la charte européenne des langues régionales ou minoritaires.

Shabak is an Indo-Iranian language and belongs to the subgroup Zaza-Gorani of the Northwestern Iranian languages. The Shabaki language is spoken by the Shabak people in the Mosul region of northern Iraq. It is a subdialect of the Kurdish dialect Gorani alongside Hewrami, Sarli, and Bajalan. It also been influenced by Arabic, Turkish and Persian language.

Sarli is an Indo-Iranian language that belongs to the Gorani group of Northwestern Iranian languages. It is spoken in northern Iraq by a cluster of villages north of the Little Zab river, on the confluence of the Khazir River and the Great Zab river, just west-northwest of the city of Kirkuk. It has fewer than 20,000 speakers. Many speakers have been displaced by conflicts in the region. It is reportedly most similar to Bajelani but is also similar to Shabaki.

Southern Kurdish (Pehlewani) is a Kurdish dialect predominantly spoken in western Iran and eastern Iraq. Native speakers use various different alphabets to write Southern Kurdish, the most common ones are extensions of the standard Kurdish alphabets (Latin or Perso-Arabic script). This language is part of the Kurdish group within the northwestern branch of the Indo-Iranian languages.

Sikkimese is a Tibetan language. It is written using Tibetan alphabet.

Le slovaque est une langue appartenant au sous-groupe des langues slaves occidentales, principalement parlée en Slovaquie, où elle est protégée par une loi linguistique.Le slovaque est très proche du tchèque.
Singapore Sign Language is a sign language used in Singapore. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Slovenian or Slovene is a member of the southern subgroup of the Slavic languages, spoken mainly in Slovenia.The distinctive characteristic of Slovene that it has preserved the use of dual grammatical number in addition to singular and plural.

Le slovène est une langue appartenant au sous-groupe méridional des langues slaves, parlée principalement en Slovénie.L’une des caractéristiques du slovène est qu’il a conservé l’usage grammatical du duel (qui représente exactement deux unités) en plus du singulier et du pluriel.
