source.description: Northern or North Sami (davvisámegiella) is the most widely spoken of all Sami languages which belong to the Finno-Ugrian branch of the Uralic languages. It is spoken in the northern parts of Norway, Sweden and Finland.Orthography of Northern Sami has experienced numerous changes.

Le same du Nord (davvisámegiella ou sámegiella) est la plus parlée des langues sames qui appartiennentà la branche finno-ougrienne des langues ouraliennes. Il est utilisé dans le nord de la Norvège, de la Suède et de la Finlande. L’orthographe du same du Nord a connu de nombreux changements.
Samoan is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Samoa and American Samoa.

Shona is a Bantu language of the Shona people of Zimbabwe. The term is variously used to collectively describe all the Central Shonic varieties (comprising Zezuru, Manyika, Korekore and Karanga) or specifically Standard Shona, a variety codified in the mid-20th century. Using the broader term, the language is spoken by over 14 000 000 people. The larger group of historically related languages – called Shona or Shonic languages – also includes Ndau (Eastern Shona) spoken in Zimbabwe, Malawi and Mozambique, and Kalanga (Western Shona) spoken in Botswana and Zimbabwe.

The Soninke language, also known as Serakhulle or Azer or Maraka, is a Mande language spoken by the Soninke people of West Africa. The language has an estimated 2.3 million speakers, primarily located in Mali and Mauritania, and also in Senegal, Ivory Coast, The Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, and Guinea. It enjoys the status of a national language in Mauritania, Mali, Senegal and The Gambia.

Somali is an Afro-Asiatic language, belonging to that family’s Cushitic branch. It is spoken as a mother tongue by ethnic Somalis.A number of writing systems have been used for transcribing the language. Of these, the Somali Latin alphabet, officially adopted in 1972, is the most widely used.

Le somali est une langue parlée dans la Corne de l’Afrique. Il appartient à la branche couchitique de la famille chamito-sémitique (également dite afro-asiatique).Différents systèmes d’écriture ont été utilisés pour transcrire le somali. L’alphabet latin somali est aujourd’hui le système d’écriture du somali le plus répandu.
Southern Sotho is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.

Spanish is a member of the Romance language family. It is spoken in Spain and in the continents of North and South America.Spanish is second after Mandarin in terms of its number of native speakers worldwide. From the last decades of the 20th century, the study of Spanish as a foreign language has grown significantly.

L’espagnol fait partie de la famille des langues romanes. Il est parlé en Espagne et en Amérique du Nord et du Sud.L’espagnol est la deuxième langue après le mandarin en termes de nombre de locuteurs natifs dans le monde entier. Depuis les dernières décennies du XXe siècle, l’étude de l’espagnol comme langue étrangère a augmenté de façon significative.

Slovakian Sign Language is a sign language used in Slovakia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

The Swahili language is a Bantu language and the mother tongue of the Swahili people. It is spoken by various communities inhabiting the African Great Lakes region and other parts of south-east Africa, mainly as a lingua franca. The closely related Comorian language, spoken in the Comoros Islands, is sometimes considered a Swahili dialect.

Les langues swahilies (souahélies) sont un groupe de langues bantoues de l’Afrique de l’Est. Elles possèdent des caractéristiques communes et surtout un vocabulaire commun qui permet à un de leurs locuteurs de se faire plus ou moins comprendre des divers locuteurs de ce groupe de langues; on ne peut parler d’intercompréhension pour toutes ces formes tant la variété linguistique est grande. La plus utilisée et populaire de ces langues est le kiswahili, une version standardisée.
Comorian is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of Comoros.

Swedish is a North Germanic language, spoken mainly in Sweden and parts of Finland. It is largely mutually intelligible with Norwegian and Danish.Swedish uses two genders: neutrum and utrum which unifies the old masculin and femenin.

Le suédois est une langue germanique septentrionale, parlée principalement en Suède et dans certaines parties de la Finlande. Il est en grande partie mutuellement intelligible avec le norvégien et le danois.Le suédois utilise deux genres: le neutrum et l’utrum qui rassemble les anciens genres masculin et féminin.
Swedish Sign Language is a sign language used in Sweden. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

source.description: Silesian or Upper Silesian is a West Slavic ethnolect of the Lechitic group spoken by a small percentage of people in Upper Silesia. Its vocabulary was significantly influenced by Central German due to the existence of numerous Silesian German speakers in the area prior to World War II and after. Some regard it as one of the four major dialects of Polish, while others classify it as a separate regional language, distinct from Polish.

Tamil is a Dravidian language spoken in South-East Asia.Tamil is one of the longest surviving classical languages in the world; ‘the only language of contemporary India which is recognisably continuous with a classical past.’Tamil was written using a script called the vaṭṭeḻuttu amongst others such as Grantha and Pallava script. The current Tamil script consists of 12 vowels, 18 consonants and one special character, the āytam. The vowels and consonants combine to form 216 compound characters, giving a total of 247 characters.

Le tamoul ou tamil est la langue des Tamouls, parlée dans l’Asie du Sud-Est. Le tamoul appartient à la famille des langues dravidiennes. C’est une des plus anciennes langues toujours parlées, restée quasi inchangée depuis environ 2 000 ans.Il s’écrit au moyen d’un alphasyllabaire dérivé du grantha.
Tetum is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of East Timor.

Tajik is a variety of modern Persian spoken in Central Asia. Most speakers of Tajik live in Tajikistan (where it is the official language) and Uzbekistan. In Afghanistan the dialect is less influenced by Turkic languages and is called Dari. The standard language is based on the north-western dialects of Tajik. Tajik also retains numerous archaic elements in its vocabulary, pronunciation, and grammar that have been lost elsewhere in the Persophone world, in part due to its relative isolation in the mountains of Central Asia.In Tajikistan and other countries of the former Soviet Union, Tajik Persian is currently written in Cyrillic script while the Perso-Arabic script is used in Iran and Afghanistan. The language is part of the Persian group within the southwestern branch of the Indo-Iranian languages.

Le tadjik ou tadjike est une langue appartenant au groupe iranien de la famille des langues indo-européennes. Cette langue est proche du persan et du dari. Le tadjik est parlé en Asie centrale, principalement au Tadjikistan (dont il est la langue officielle), et par des minorités linguistiques en Afghanistan, en Iran, en Ouzbékistan et dans le Xinjiang, région autonome de Chine.Au Tadjikistan et en Ouzbékistan, la langue s’écrit au moyen d’un alphabet cyrillique augmenté de signes diacritiques. En revanche, dans les autres pays, elle est transcrite au moyen de l’alphabet perso-arabe. La langue fait partie du groupe persan dans la branche sud-ouest des langues indo-iraniennes.

Thai, or more precisely Siamese or Central Thai, is a member of the Tai group of the Tai–Kadai language family. It is a tonal and analytic language. Thai also has a complex orthography and relational markers. Thai is mutually intelligible with Lao.The Thais adopted and modified the Khmer script to create their own writing system. It is an abugida script.

Le thaï ou siamois ou Thai-An est une langue du groupe taï de la famille des langues taï-kadaï.Le thaï utilise un alphasyllabaire particulier (alphabet thaï) dérivé de l’alphabet khmer issu de l’alphabet pâli, adapté pour pouvoir transcrire le système tonal de la langue.

Tigrinya is an Afro-Asiatic language, belonging to the family’s Semitic branch. It is spoken by ethnic Tigray-Tigrinya in the Horn of Africa.Tigrinya is written in the Ge’ez script, originally developed for Ge’ez, also called Ethiopic. The Ge’ez script is an abugida: each symbol represents a consonant + vowel syllable, and the symbols are organised in groups of similar symbols on the basis of both the consonant and the vowel.

Le tigrigna ou tigrinya est une langue éthiosémitique parlée essentiellement au nord-est de la Corne de l’Afrique.Le tigrigna s’écrit au moyen d’une version de l’alphasyllabaire guèze auquel s’ajoutent quelques caractères.
Tokelauan is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Tokelau.
Tacana is a Tacanan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.
Toromono is a Tacanan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Tonga is a Bantu language spoken in Zambia, where it has the status of a regional language, and in Zimbabwe, where it is one of the 16 official languages. It is spoken around Lake Kariba in Zambia by almost a million people and in Zimbabwe around 140 000 people. It is also spoken in northern Zimbabwe, with a few in Mozambique. Tonga is the mother tongue of the Tonga people. In Zambia Tonga is taught in schools as first language in the whole of Southern Province, Lusaka and Central Provinces.
Tongan is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Tonga.
Tok Pisin is an English-based creole language. It is one of the official languages of Papua New Guinea.
Tapieté is a Tupian indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.
Trinitario is an Arawakan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.
Tunisian Sign Language is a sign language used in Tunisia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Turkish Sign Language is a sign language used in Turkey. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Tswana is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.
Tsonga is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.
Thai Sign Language is a sign language used in Thailand. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Taiwan Sign Language is a sign language used in Taiwan. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Tebul Sign Language is a sign language used in Uluban village in Mali. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Turkmen or Turkoman is spoken in Asia. Turkmen is a member of the East Oghuz branch of the Turkic family of languages; its closest relatives being Anatolian Turkish and Azerbaijani, with which it shares a relatively high degree of mutual intelligibility.Officially, Turkmen currently is rendered in the ‘Täze Elipbiý’, or ‘New Alphabet’, which is based on the Latin alphabet. However, the old ‘Soviet’ Cyrillic alphabet is still in wide use.

Le turkmène est une langue appartenant au groupe des langues turques, parlée en Asie centrale, principalement au Turkménistan.Le turkmène a été écrit avec un alphabet arabe adapté, puis un alphabet latin jusqu’en 1940. L’État soviétique force alors l’adoption d’une variante de l’alphabet cyrillique pour l’écriture du turkmène. Depuis 1997, l’alphabet officiel est une variante de l’alphabet latin avec quelques diacritiques, proche de celui du turc.

Turkish is the most widely spoken of the Turkic languages in south-eastern Europe and western Asia. It is closely related to Azeri and Turkmen.In 1928, as one of Atatürk’s Reforms, the Arabic script was replaced with a Latin alphabet.

Le turc est la plus parlée des langues turques en Europe du Sud et en Asie occidentale. Il est très proche de l’azéri et du turkmène.En 1928, l’une des réformes d’Atatürk fut de remplacer l’écriture arabe par l’alphabet latin.
Tuvaluan is a Malayo-Polynesian language. It is one of the official languages of Tuvalu.
Tanzanian Sign Language is a sign language used in Tanzania. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Central Atlas Tamazight is a Berber language of the Afroasiatic language family spoken in the Atlas Mountains of Central Morocco as well as by smaller emigrant communities in France and elsewhere. It is one of the most-spoken Berber languages. It is officially written in the Tifinagh script for instruction in Moroccan schools while descriptive linguistic literature commonly uses the Latin alphabet, and the Arabic alphabet has also been used.
Ugandan Sign Language is a sign language used in Uganda. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Uruguayan Sign Language is a sign language used in Uruguay. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Ukrainian Sign Language is a sign language used in Ukraine. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Ukrainian is one of the East Slavic languages and shares many grammatical and lexical features with other members of the branch, Russian and Belorusian. It is spoken mainly in Ukraine.Ukrainian is written with the Cyrillic alphabet.

L’ukrainien fait partie des langues slaves et partage de nombreuses caractéristiques grammaticales et lexicales avec d’autres langues de cette branche, le russe et le biélorusse. Il est parlé principalement en Ukraine.L’ukrainien s’écrit avec l’alphabet cyrillique.

Urubú-Kaapor Sign Language is a village sign language used by Ka’apor people in Brazilia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Undetermined is provided for those situations in which a language or languages must be indicated but the language cannot be identified.
«Indéterminé»: pour les situations dans lesquelles une ou plusieurs langues doivent être signalées mais la langue ne peut pas être identifiée.

Urdu is a standardised register of the Hindustani language. Urdu is historically associated with the Muslims of the region of Hindustan.Urdu is written right-to-left in an extension of the Persian alphabet, which is itself an extension of the Arabic alphabet. Urdu is associated with the Nastaʿlīq style of Persian calligraphy.

L’ourdou ou urdu est une langue appartenant au groupe indo-iranien de la famille des langues indo-européennes.En Inde, il est connu sous le nom de «hindi» et s’écrit en caractères sanskrits, mais ses locuteurs musulmans le nomment «ourdou» et l’écrivent en caractères arabes, comme au Pakistan.
Uru is an Uru-Chipaya indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Uzbek is an Eastern Turkic language and is spoken by the Uzbeks in Uzbekistan and elsewhere in Central Asia.Until 1992, Uzbek continued to be written using a Cyrillic alphabet almost everywhere, but now in Uzbekistan the Latin script has been officially re-introduced, although the use of Cyrillic is still widespread.

L’ouzbek est une langue appartenant au groupe des langues turques de la famille des langues altaïques. Il est surtout utilisé en Asie centrale, principalement en Ouzbékistan.L’alphabet ouzbek fut perso-arabe, latin, cyrillique et, à partir de 1992, à nouveau latin mais remanié. De nos jours, l’écriture en ouzbek cyrillique reste encore très largement employée. Les Ouzbeks de Chine utilisent un alphabet arabe modifié.
Venda is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.

Vietnamese is the native language of Vietnamese people. It is part of the Austroasiatic language family of which it has, by far, the most speakers.The Vietnamese alphabet (quốc ngữ) in use today is a Latin alphabet with additional diacritics for tones, and certain letters.

Le vietnamien appartient à la branche môn-khmère des langues austro-asiatiques. Il est la langue austro-asiatique qui possède le plus de locuteurs. C’est une langue isolante et monosyllabique, dotée d’un système de 6 tons.Dans l’écriture latinisée utilisée actuellement, le Quốc ngữ, les mots figurent comme une succession de monosyllabes.

Using Flemish for the official language in Flanders is misleading: the only official language in Flanders is standard Dutch.

Le flamand (vlaams) ou belge néerlandais est la langue néerlandaise parlée en Flandre, la partie nord de la Belgique.Les différences entre le flamand et le néerlandais sont minimes. L’utilisation du flamand comme langue officielle en Flandre est trompeuse: la seule langue officielle en Flandre est le néerlandais standard.

Valencian Sign Language is a sign language used in the Valencian community, in Spain. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Walloon is a Romance language, a langue d’oïl dialect indigenous to the greater part of Wallonia, the French-speaking south part of Belgium.Numerous associations are working to keep the language alive. On a government level, Walloon is officially recognised as a regional indigenous language.

Le wallon est une langue romane, une langue d’oïl autochtone dans la plus grande partie de la Wallonie, la partie sud de Belgique parlant français.De nombreuses associations travaillent à garder la langue vivante. Au niveau du gouvernement, le wallon est officiellement reconnu comme une langue autochtone régionale.
Wolof belongs to the Senegambian branch of the Niger–Congo language family. It is the native language of the Wolof people and is spoken in Senegal, the Gambia and Mauritania.
Wu is a major group of Sinitic languages spoken primarily in Shanghai, Zhejiang Province and the part of Jiangsu Province south of the Yangtze River, which makes up the cultural region of Wu.
Xhosa is a Bantu language. It is one of the official languages of South Africa.
Kenyan Sign Language is a sign language used in Kenya. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Malaysian Sign Language is a sign language used in Malaysia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Middle Persian written in the Manichaean script is a Western Middle Iranian language which became the literary language of the Sasanian Empire. It is the linguistic ancestor of Modern Persian, the official language of Iran (also known as Farsi), Afghanistan (Dari) and Tajikistan (Tajik).
Moroccan Sign Language is a sign language used in Morocco. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Yaminava is a Panoan indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

source.description: Yiddish is a Germanic language, the historical language of the Ashkenazi Jews in central and east Europe.Yiddish is traditionally written in a fully vocalised variety of Hebrew script. A transliteration into the Latin alphabet is quite often used.

Le yiddish est une langue germanique, la langue historique des Juifs ashkénazes d’Europe centrale et orientale.Il est traditionnellement écrit dans une variante entièrement vocalisée de l’écriture hébraïque. Une transcription en alphabet latin est très souvent utilisée.

Yoruba is an Atlantic-Congo language that belongs to the Volta Niger group spoken in West Africa, most prominently in Southwestern Nigeria. It is spoken by the ethnic Yoruba people. Yoruba was – and still partially is – written in the Ajami script, a form of Arabic script but the language is mainly written in two special versions of the Latin alphabet, the Nigerian and the Beninese forms. It is part of the hypothetical Niger-Congo language family.

Yugoslavian Sign Language is a sign language used in countries of the former Yougoslavia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.
Yue Chinese, often referred as Cantonese, is a Chinese language. It is one of the official languages of Hong Kong and Macau. Yue Chinese is written in Chinese characters.
Yuqui is a Tupian indigenous language. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.
Yuracare is an indigenous language isolate. It is one of the official languages of Bolivia.

Chinese is a group of related but often mutually unintelligible language varieties, forming one of the two Sinitic branches within the Sino-Tibetan language family. It is often collectively referred to as zhōngwén, meaning the Chinese language or script. Hànyǔ refers to the Chinese language spoken by the Han ethnic group, the majority ethnicity in China. All varieties of Chinese are tonal and analytic.The written form of the standard language, wén, based on the logograms known as Chinese characters, is shared by literate speakers of otherwise unintelligible dialects.

Les langues chinoises ou langues sinitiques, souvent désignées dans leur ensemble sous le nom de «chinois» (zhōngwén), appartiennent à la famille des langues sino-tibétaines.Dans leur caractère le plus universel, on considère la langue écrite, transcendant la prononciation des divers parlers. La langue parlée dans son caractère le plus général est le plus souvent appelée «hanyu», même si d’autres groupes ethniques ont progressivement adopté cette langue.
Zimbabwe Sign Language is a sign language used in Zimbabwe. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Malay is a major language of the Austronesian family. The Standard Malay has various official names; in Singapore and Brunei this individual language is called Bahasa Melayu (Malay). Malay is written using the Arabic or the Latin script.
Zambian Sign Language is a sign language used in Zambia. Sign languages are languages which mainly use signs made with the hands, the arms or the body and facial expressions.

Zulu is the language of the Zulu people, the vast majority of whom live in South Africa. Zulu is the second most widely spoken Bantu language after Shona.Like many other Bantu languages, it is written using the Latin alphabet.Standard Zulu as it is taught in schools (deep Zulu), differs in various respects from the language spoken by people living in cities (urban Zulu).

Le zoulou est une langue appartenant au groupe nguni des langues bantoues (qui comprend également le xhosa et le ndébélé). C’est l’une des langues les plus répandues en Afrique.Le zoulou, comme toutes les langues indigènes d’Afrique du Sud, était une langue orale jusqu’à l’arrivée de missionnaires européens, qui l’ont transcrit en utilisant l’alphabet latin.

source.description: The Slavic or Slavonic languages, a group of closely related languages of the Slavic peoples and a subgroup of Indo-European languages, have speakers in most of eastern Europe, much of the Balkans, parts of central Europe, and the northern part of Asia.Slavic languages are usually divided on the basis of geographical and genealogical principle into three main branches: East, West and South Slavic branchs.The Slavic languages are a relatively homogeneous and conservative family, compared with other families of Indo-European languages. Most Slavic languages have a rich, fusional morphology.

Les langues slaves sont des langues indo-européennes, du groupe balto-slave. Elles forment un groupe de langues important dont les locuteurs se trouvent majoritairement en Europe centrale, dans les Balkans, en Europe de l’Est, en Sibérie, en Extrême-Orient russe et en Asie centrale.Les langues slaves sont généralement divisées sur la base des principes géographique et généalogique en trois branches principales: orientale (qui utilise l’alphabet cyrillique), occidentale (qui utilise l’alphabet latin) et méridionale (qui utilise l’alphabet cyrillique ou latin).Les langues slaves forment une famille relativement homogène et conservatrice en comparaison aux autres familles de langues indo-européennes. La plupart des langues slaves ont une riche morphologie fusionnelle.

source.description: Valencian is a Catalan dialect spoken in the Valencian Community in Spain.The Valencian Academy of the Language considers Catalan and Valencian to be simply two names for the same language.

Le valencien est un dialecte catalan parlé dans la Communauté de Valence en Espagne.L’Académie valencienne de la langue considère simplement le catalan et le valencien comme deux noms pour la même langue.

Malaysian, or Standard Malay, is the official language of Malaysia and a standardised register of the Malacca dialect of Malay. It is a compulsory subject in primary and secondary school. The Malaysian name for the language is Bahasa Malaysia (literally ‘the language of Malaysia’).The Malaysian language is normally written using a Latin alphabet called Rumi, though an Arabic alphabet called Jawi also exists.

Le malais ou malaisien (bahasa Malaysia, littéralement «langue de la Malaisie») est l’appellation officielle de la langue nationale de la Malaisie. Il exprime une volonté politique de fédérer les diverses communautés du pays grâce à une langue partagée par tous les citoyens. Le malaisien est une des formes du malais, appelé également «malais standard». Il est enseigné dans toutes les écoles du pays et sert d’outil de communication interethnique.Le malais moderne et l’indonésien s’écrivent avec l’alphabet latin, tandis que le malais classique utilise l’alphabet arabe.

source.description: Moldavian or Moldovan is a name of the Romanian language in the Republic of Moldova. The identity between the mother tongues of the Moldovans and Romanians has been officially acknowledged since the reintroduction of the Latin script in 1989; the 1991 Declaration of Independence of Moldova thereupon called the official language ‘Romanian’. Nevertheless, the 1994 Constitution only provided official status to ‘Moldovan’. In the early 2000s the Parliament of the Republic of Moldova adopted a law defining ‘Moldovan’ and ‘Romanian’ as designations for the same language (glottonyms). The breakaway region of Transnistria continues to recognise ‘Moldovan’ as one of its official languages.

Le moldave est, selon l’article 13 de sa Constitution, la langue officielle de la République de Moldavie. C’est une dénomination politique; du point de vue strictement linguistique et en termes de sociolinguistique, le roumain et le moldave sont une seule et même langue, dont les anciens dialectes et les formes actuelles présentent assez de traits structurels communs scientifiquement établis pour constituer une langue unitaire. Les locuteurs se comprennent spontanément et complètement sans traducteur ni dictionnaire. Les différences entre parler savant (langue littéraire moderne) et parlers populaires sont les mêmes en Moldavie et en Roumanie. Le nom scientifique de cette langue, adopté par tous les linguistes, est «daco-roumain» ou «daco-roman».

Montenegrin is the standardised variety of the Serbo-Croatian used by Montenegrins. It is based on the Shtokavian dialect of Serbo-Croatian.Montenegrin uses more the Latin alphabet than the Cyrillic. In both alphabets there are two additional letters.

Le monténégrin est la variante normalisée du serbo-croate utilisé par les Monténégrins. Il est basé sur le dialecte chtokavien du serbo-croate.Le monténégrin emploie plus l’alphabet latin que cyrillique. Dans les deux alphabets, il y a deux lettres supplémentaires.

Northern Ping is a member of a pair of Sinitic languages spoken mainly in Guilin in northern Guangxi and in Hunan. Pinghua is a trade language, and many of its speakers are genetically distinct from most other Han Chinese.

Southern Ping Chinese is a member of a pair of Sinitic languages spoken mainly in southern Guangxi, around the city of Nanning. Pinghua is a trade language spoken as a second language by speakers of Zhuang languages. Some speakers are officially classified as Zhuang, and many are genetically distinct from most other Han Chinese.

Standard Moroccan Tamazight is a Berber language of the Afroasiatic language family spoken in Morocco. It is a standardized language developed by the Royal Institute of Amazigh Culture (IRCAM) in Morocco by combining features of Tashelhit, Central Atlas Tamazight and Tarifit, the three major Amazigh languages in Morocco. It has been an official language of Morocco since 2011.
